summary: Frontend-only verification of the green->Facebook-blue rebrand and the Impressum legal-entity change. Tested all 7 public pages (/, /unternehmen, /dienstleistungen, /karriere, /kontakt, /impressum, /datenschutz) with a programmatic computed-color scan (flagging any element whose color/background/border has a dominant green channel), verified logo/favicon fills, navbar+footer navigation, Kontakt & Karriere form rendering, and logged into the employee panel (mitarbeiter@precision-labs.de) to scan dashboard/auftrage/chat/einstellungen. Result: PUBLIC SITE IS 100% GREEN-FREE and Facebook blue (#1877F2/#166FE5 confirmed on navbar active link, CTA, stat numbers, eyebrows, icon tiles, links; footer bg = rgb(11,30,59) navy). Impressum shows all required NEXURA data. Two leftovers found in the employee area: emerald-green provision widgets and the OLD legal entity text still inside the employee contract components.

GREEN REMNANT: text-emerald-600 total provision (rgb(5,150,105)) and bg-emerald-100/text-emerald-700 provision badges per task.

Navbar logo rect fill=#1877F2, admin /admin/login TdataLogo fill=#1877F2, public/favicon.svg + index.html theme-color=#1877F2.

Navbar navigation to all 5 pages works, no white screens, ZERO console errors on public site.
Kontakt form renders 6 fields + visible submit; Karriere form renders 12 fields.

Employee login works, sidebar active item is blue (color rgb(22,111,229) / bg rgb(235,242,254)), branding 'Tdata Testing' intact; /mitarbeiter/chat and /mitarbeiter/einstellungen are fully green-free.
Admin tokyo-night green (#9ece6a) left as-is per instructions (not reported as a bug).

Update the employee contract components (MitarbeiterContractSign.jsx, ContractTemplates.jsx, MitarbeiterVertrag.jsx) to NEXURA GmbH / Lohnrößlerweg 12 / 81829 München / Johannes Liebert and change place of signature from Ginsheim-Gustavsburg to München.
critical_code_review_comments: Legal-entity strings are duplicated across at least 4 files; extract to a single constants module (e.g. src/config/company.js) so future entity changes cannot leave stale copies.
Logo.jsx header comment still describes 'a calm sage-green square with a serif T' - misleading after the blue rebrand.
MitarbeiterVertrag.jsx is imported nowhere (no route) - dead code carrying outdated legal text; delete it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Colour verification was done programmatically by scanning getComputedStyle for all elements and flagging g>r+12 && g>b+12; reuse that approach. Public site + employee chat/einstellungen are clean. Remaining green is only the emerald provision widgets (dashboard 'Provision gesamt' tile, auftrage provision text/badges). Admin panel green #9ece6a is intentional. Old MO Handel/Ginsheim text remains only in employee contract components; to see it live you need an employee whose contract is unsigned (MitarbeiterLayout renders MitarbeiterContractSign modal).
rca_of_the_issue: The rebrand swapped the 'sage' Tailwind scale and hardcoded green hexes, but semantic Tailwind color names (emerald-*) used for money/success widgets were not part of the swap, and the legal-entity update covered only public pages (Impressum/Footer/Kontakt/Datenschutz), missing the employee contract templates.
